PluginInfo.Name: Web (based on WebKit)
PluginInfo.Description:
Seamlessly integrate browser-based management consoles into your workflow.

Quickly access web pages or web based management consoles, such as Firewall or Router configuration interfaces, System Center Web Consoles, Sharepoint, etc.

The convenient Auto Fill feature lets you automatically complete web forms based on values defined in the connection or assigned credentials.

Auto Fill
  • Automatically fill login forms
  • HTML element to value mapping
  • Replacement token support
  • Credential management support
  • Option to retry auto fill until success
  • Support for configuring auto fill delay

Advanced Features
  • Navigation Toolbar
  • Built-in download manager
  • Basic authentication support
  • Customizable cookie storage mode
  • Customizable User Agent String
  • Secure Gateway support
